messages:
Marta (AE): Heads-up: enterprise bank requires Private deploy. Must keep original client 5-tuple for logging, static egress IPs for allowlist, and contractual burst headroom (2x for 15m). Any immediate blockers?
Hal (SE): If they insist on no SNAT, PrivateLink is out for L4 preservation. TGW or VPC peering with direct routing to our connector subnets is needed. Do they allow TGW attachments?
Alec (Customer): TGW is allowed but needs change control. We can do peering too. No managed NAT allowed in our VPCs.
Jin (NetOps): Operational notes: 1) Ensure route tables point to connector subnets; 2) disable source/dest check on routed instances if we host routers; 3) reserved EIP pool recommended for static egress — avoid on-demand EIPs due to quotas.
Sofia (Solutions Eng): Quick allowlist snippet for compliance: "Allow outbound to connector CIDRs on TCP/443; allow healthchecks on TCP/80; DNS to customer resolvers; ensure TGW routes to connector subnets. For L4 client IP preservation use TGW/VPC peering with no SNAT."
Marta (AE): Pricing/SLA asks: can we offer a burst throughput SLA?
Hal (SE): Burst SLA only with Dedicated reserved nodes. Otherwise burst is best-effort. Ballpark: baseline cluster for ~300 rps = ~$11k/mo; burst buffer + reserved EIPs adds ~30%. Legal needs to sign addendum for throughput SLO.
Alec (Customer): Ok send the network paragraph for our questionnaire and a short test runbook.
Sofia (Solutions Eng): Drafted paragraph and runbook snippet sent to Alec via DM. Runbook includes traceroute/tcpdump checks to verify src IP and curl latency checks.
InfraBot: Preflight checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-tgw-preflight created (contains route table examples, SG snippets, EIP reservation steps).
Marta (AE): Next: schedule architecture review Thu 11am PT with customer's netsec. I'll attach the checklist. :white_check_mark:
